description: Version-31 direct recurrent PPO for hazard-weighted time-to-safety. Every active pedestrian accrues one unit of time cost plus normalized hazard exposure until genuine arrival or actual shelter admission; casualties receive a dominating penalty and unfinished pedestrians retain terminal continuation debt. The actor executes its own categorical shelter sample and receives exact common-noise credit against an independent shelter sampled from the same behavior policy, so learning ranks capacity-matched installations rather than comparing every installation with WAIT. NMCC never proposes, masks, gates, corrects, or replaces an action. There is no heuristic prior, fitted correction, fallback controller, staged pretraining, teacher, benefit filter, or hazard-proxy action censor. The action mask contains only structural executability: an available positive-capacity site and a remaining deployment token.
